items.title: Joe Muranyi interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 11, 2007
items.q: So my first dollar with the clarinet, would you believe, was a gig in Trenton, New Jersey and the bass player was Pops Foster.

ctx.x: How did you make your first dollar with your clarinet?

Oh, oh, oh. Well this is very deep. So anyhow, well let me finish the story about my sister. So I went home with the clarinet and I started to practice and she laughed and said “you sound like a duck,” which led me to practice. And I evidently improved very quickly. I mean I just ate it up. So then I ended up in high school and I played in the high school band. And I never got into athletics much, you know, football. “You’d make a good football player” you know. I wanted to play the clarinet. So my first dollar…
